title: stachys germanica var. spectabilis
intro: Stachys germanica var. spectabilis, commonly known as upright hedgenettle, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can aid in wound healing and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of upright hedgenettle include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and relieve respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
